identity.name: Indian Creek Village
identity.hoa_name: Not applicable — governed as an incorporated municipality (Village of Indian Creek), not a traditional HOA
identity.notes: Indian Creek Village is an incorporated municipality and man-made barrier island in Miami-Dade County, Florida, incorporated May 17, 1939 (founded 1928). It comprises 41 residential home sites and the Indian Creek Country Club. Known as the "Billionaire Bunker," it features a council–manager government, its own police department (24/7), and is governed by municipal Land Development Regulations rather than a traditional HOA. Services are funded through property taxes. Contact: (305) 865-4121; village@indiancreekvillagefl.gov; https://indiancreekvillagefl.gov/; Mailing: 9080 Bay Drive, Indian Creek Village, FL 33154.

fees.note: No traditional HOA dues apply. The community is an incorporated municipality funded primarily through property taxes. Specific tax rates or municipal fee amounts are not stated in the available content. Village office: (305) 865-4121.

amenities.detail: Indian Creek Country Club occupies most of the island's land. The village is classified as a golf course community.
Gated community with 24/7 municipal police protection and its own police department. Village motto: 'Protect. Serve.'
Private man-made barrier island with exclusive waterfront estates. Part of the Miami metropolitan area of South Florida.

103-page municipal code governs building size (min 5,000 sq ft GFA for principal buildings), setbacks, lot coverage (max 25% building coverage), landscaping, height limits, and restrictions on pools, docks, generators, walls, guest houses, paving, and animals. Violations may incur fines up to $500/day.
